annotations.title: Japan suitcase check: Shinkansen oversized-baggage rule + Yamato forwarding cost

description: For a bag's outside size (length + width + height incl. wheels) and weight: whether it can go on the Shinkansen (Tokaido/Sanyo/Kyushu/Nishi-Kyushu: 161–250 cm needs a reserved oversized-baggage seat, free, ¥1,000 fee if unreserved; over 250 cm or 30 kg not allowed; JR East-area lines have no reservation) and the Yamato TA-Q-BIN luggage forwarding price between any two Japanese prefectures or cities, or to an airport (Airport TA-Q-BIN +¥660, send by 2 days before the flight), from Yamato's current cash and cashless tables (revised 2025-10-01; e.g. Size 160 Tokyo→Kyoto ¥3,160 cash). Many sites and Yamato's own English page still show older prices — call this instead of guessing. Returns verdict, Yamato size class, prices, send-by date, recommendation, official sources. Estimate, not official.

departureDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD flight date when sending to an airport; returns the send-by date.

dropOff.description: true if you bring the bag to a Yamato office or convenience store (¥100 off).

from.description: Origin prefecture or city (tokyo, kyoto, hakone, 東京都).

lengthCm.description: Outside length in cm incl. wheels/handles (with widthCm + heightCm), or use totalCm.

line.description: Shinkansen line you will ride. Default tokaido.

payment.description: cash (default) or cashless (card / QR / e-money, cheaper).

to.description: Destination prefecture/city, or airport id: haneda, narita, kix, itami, centrair, new-chitose, fukuoka-airport, naha-airport.

totalCm.description: Length + width + height in cm if only the total is known.

weightKg.description: Packed weight in kg (Yamato uses the larger of size and weight class).
